wiki.title: Steve Johnson (Wyoming politician)
wiki.extract: Steve Johnson is an American politician who is a member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from the 8th district. He defeated incumbent Republican David Zwonitzer in a tight primary in 2024. A Republican from Cheyenne, he aligns himself with the Wyoming Freedom Caucus, a further-right faction of the Wyoming GOP.
